name: Ryu vs Ken — Who Gets the Last Hadouken
title: Who gets the last Hadouken? 🔥 Ryu vs Ken (endless round)
description:
Ryu and Ken. One endless round. Neither of them will let the other have the last word… or the last Hadouken. ∞

Every Hadouken is bigger than the last one. Nobody wins. Watch it loop.
disclaimer: A cartoon parody. Characters are comedic impressions of Ryu and Ken (voice impressions, AI-altered); not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom.
pinnedComment: Whose Hadouken was stronger — Ryu's or Ken's? 👇
checklist: Turn on the platform's AI / altered-or-synthetic-content label (cloned, modified voices).
Keep the parody line and "not affiliated with Capcom" in the description (voice policy).
No music in the mix: if an in-app track is added, keep it under the voices and check its reuse terms.
Cover = frame 1 (both fighters in the Hadouken wind-up, health bars + ∞).
Turn on loop/replay where the platform offers it: the last frame leads straight back into frame 1.
